summary: Attacker conducted a SSH password brute force attack from 192.168.1.105, successfully compromised the 'admin_user' account on 'srv-prod-db01', and immediately executed sudo to inspect sensitive credential files (/etc/shadow).
root_cause: Weak SSH password policy and exposed SSH port allowing password authentication for administrative user 'admin_user'.
mitre_tactics: TA0001: Initial Access (Credential Stuffing / Brute Force)

reasoning_steps.action: Analyzed authentication log entries for source IP 192.168.1.105.
reasoning_steps.finding: Identified multiple failed login attempts against root within a 12-second window.

reasoning_steps.action: Correlated successful SSH login immediately following brute force attempts.
reasoning_steps.finding: User 'admin_user' logged in successfully from the same attacking IP address (192.168.1.105).

reasoning_steps.action: Evaluated process execution logs for 'admin_user' post-login.
reasoning_steps.finding: Command '/usr/bin/cat /etc/shadow' was run via sudo within 48 seconds of login, indicating active post-exploitation credential harvesting.

evidence.relevance: Confirms initial access gained via valid credentials.
Direct proof of privilege escalation and credential dumping.

response_actions.title: Block Source IP 192.168.1.105
response_actions.description: Add IP address 192.168.1.105 to edge firewall blocklist to halt active session.

response_actions.title: Force Password Reset & Revoke SSH Keys for admin_user
response_actions.description: Invalidate current session tokens and enforce credential reset for compromised user account.

response_actions.title: Isolate Host srv-prod-db01 for Forensic Sampling
response_actions.description: Apply network isolation to host srv-prod-db01 to prevent potential lateral movement while retaining memory state.
